description.narrative: Förstärkt genomförande av Armeniens avfallspolicy genom: 1) Framstagande av regelverk för införande av producentansvar, kapacitetsbyggande samt inköp av dataprogram för hantering av avfallsinformation, samt 2) framtagande av nationell model för källsortering (hushållsnivå), genomförande av pilotinsats i en kommun, inklusive kapacitietsbyggande, informationskampanj och utrustning (en sopbil och avfallskärl).

Strengthened implementation of Armenia's waste management policy through 1) Development of legal framework for an Extended Producer Responsibility, capacity building and purchase of data management system IT) and 2) development of a national model for household source separation, implementation of a pilot project on source separation in one Municipality, including capacity building, information and awareness campaign and purchase of one refuse vehicle and waste bins.

The Program aims at improving the sector capacity to implement environmentally sound waste management practices through the following three outcomes:
• Outcome from Component 1: EPR legislation and system developed • Outcome from Component 2: Waste source separation national model developed and introduced as a system in a target municipality (from Kotayk or Gegharkunik province) • Outcome from Component 3: Capacities built for achieving Outcome 1 and Outcome 2, as well as for scaling up the achieved results

Summary of progress reported for period July 2023 - January 2024
During the reporting period, progress was made in both of the main programme components Developing and adopting EPR legislation for several specific waste streams in line with EU Waste legislation and best practices (Component 1) and Developing source separation national model and introducing it as a system in a pilot municipality (Component 2). The main achievement towards programme outcomes highlighted for Component 1 is the development of a first draft Law on Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) which was submitted to RA Ministry of Environment and key programs stakeholders for internal review. The production of the revised version of the draft law with incorporated feedback from the key stakeholders is then published on the official policy and legislation review platform (https://www.edraft.am/en) by the Ministry of Environment.
As part of Program Component 2, the draft Operational Plan for Source Separation of Waste in Sevan town was finalized during the reporting period. Based on the draft operational plan and agreed collection scheme, waste sorting equipment procurement for Sevan town was initiated. As part of the procurement, a market analysis was conducted to assess the availability of specific equipment and its cost ranges on the regional market. The procurement of equipment is coordinated with the MTAI and Sida (who provides no objection to terms and reports for major procurements).
An independent agent for monitoring support has reviewed progress of implementation in relation to plans and reported a high level of indicator achievement for the Program: Out of 109 activities during the reporting period, 88% of the expected outputs were either achieved or overachieved (82% achievement and 6% of over-achievement). Related analysis of deviations attributed one case of external factors while in two other cases, planning issues were the cause (i.e. for Output Indicators "3.8a: Number of stakeholder engagement activities facilitated on topics such as EPR, bio-waste management, hazardous waste management, circularity, and higher value recovery from waste, and landfill management in Armenia with the engagement of governmental agencies and sector stakeholders" and "3.8b: Number of stakeholders that have been involved in stakeholder engagement activities"). The Program Management reports that the initial timeline failed to accurately represent the project's objectives, leading to a misalignment in the planning and execution of stakeholder engagement activities. The delays are expected to be caught up during 2024.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
